730a0b.title: RLS & Access-Control verification matrix — Loja Online (Vitta Basics)
730a0b.content:
## Verification result: no distinct access-control finding beyond the admin-claim escalation issue

Per-table RLS assessment of `supabase/migrations/20260815231300_schema.sql`:

| Table | Command | Policy | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| products | SELECT | true | Public catalog (by design) — C:N |
| products | INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE | `auth.jwt()->'user_metadata'->>'role'='admin'` | Client-controlled claim — root cause of escalation (covered by admin-escalation report) |
| categories | SELECT | true | Public (by design) |
| categories | INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE | admin claim | Same escalation root cause |
| orders | INSERT | `auth.uid() = user_id` (WITH CHECK) | **Secure** — confirmed: user_id supplied by client must equal JWT `sub`; cannot be forged. Cross-user insert rejected. |
| orders | SELECT | `auth.uid() = user_id OR admin claim` | Secure horizontally; OR-branch inherits escalation root cause |
| orders | UPDATE | admin claim only | Customers default-denied (good control); sole enforcement is flawed claim |
| orders | DELETE | none | Default deny for everyone (over-restrictive, not a vuln) |
| order_items | INSERT | `order_id IN (SELECT id FROM orders WHERE user_id=auth.uid()) OR admin` | **Secure** — policy subqueries run as policy owner, accurate; items can only attach to own orders |
| order_items | SELECT | same subquery OR admin | Secure horizontally |
| order_items | UPDATE/DELETE | none | Default deny for everyone — secure |

## Client-side-only admin gating (confirmed)
- `App.tsx:294` renders `TomatoAdminPanel` only when `isAuthenticated && isAdmin`; `isAdmin = state.user?.role === 'admin'` (`AuthContext.tsx:81`); role sourced from `user_metadata.role` (`mapSupabaseUser`, `authService.ts`). No other enforcement exists (no Edge Functions, no RPC, no custom backend; only PostgREST + RLS).
- `updateOrderStatus()` (`tomatoApi.ts:584`) has no code-level authz — total reliance on the admin-claim RLS UPDATE policy. Customers cannot change even their own order status (RLS default-deny).
- Admin provisioning gate is client-side only: `VITE_ADMIN_SECRET_KEY` (`authService.ts:38`) is a `VITE_` var inlined into the public bundle; `signUp` sends `options.data.role` client-side; Supabase Auth stores any self-asserted metadata. This is the escalation chain — referenced, not duplicated.

## IDOR check results
- `getProductById` — products public by design.
- `getOrders` (`tomatoApi.ts:556`) — RLS-scoped (own orders + own order_items); embedded `order_items(*)` sub-policy also scoped. No cross-user read.
- `updateOrderStatus(orderId)` — RLS denies customers even for their own orders.
- `createOrder` — app hardcodes `user_id: session.user.id`; direct PostgREST calls with another user's UUID fail WITH CHECK. Reasoning confirmed.

## Non-findings (honest classification)
- **localStorage fallback in getOrders** returns `INITIAL_ORDERS` (3 fictional demo records — names/emails/addresses) when no session/error. Data is static demo content already shipped in the public JS bundle; rendered only inside the client-gated admin panel. No restricted data exposure → not reported.
- **Search `.or()` filter interpolation** (`tomatoApi.ts:120`) — values parameterized by PostgREST (no SQLi); products table public-read, so filter/wildcard manipulation has no cross-user impact. Not reported.
- **order_items / orders missing UPDATE-DELETE policies** — default deny = secure (over-restrictive for admins only).

## Observations for other tracks
- `createOrder` accepts client-supplied `totalAmount`, item `price`, `quantity`, customer name/email/address with zero server-side validation (RLS only checks user_id binding) → order-record forgery / amount tampering (business-logic/integrity track; low impact in this demo without payment/fulfillment).
- `AdminLoginPage.tsx` prefills/hints `admin@vittabasics.com / admin123` (weak-credential track, demo hint).

## Evidence references
- Schema: `supabase/migrations/20260815231300_schema.sql` (policies lines ~66-127)
- `src/services/authService.ts` (mapSupabaseUser ~10-17; signUp secret gate ~30-50)
- `src/context/AuthContext.tsx:81` (isAdmin)
- `src/App.tsx:294` (admin panel gate)
- `src/services/tomatoApi.ts` (556 getOrders, 584 updateOrderStatus, 604 createOrder)
